title: Aviateka validation row / строка таблицы сверки

tool.description: Tool id from data/tools, or null for a code outside the catalog / id из каталога или null

tool_name.description: Required when tool is null / обязательно, если tool = null

reference.description: What it was compared with / с чем сравнивали

parameter.description: What varies along the points, e.g. trim_deg, alpha_deg, h_over_c / что меняется по точкам

quantity.description: CL, CD, Cm, neutral point, flutter speed… / величина

diff_pct.description: Mismatch with the reference, % as the source gives it / расхождение, %

kind.description: published = from a paper or report; community = sent by a user / из статьи или от участника

added_by.description: GitHub login or 'editorial' / логин или editorial
